errors.evidence: The vertical axis itself is not labeled with a value range. The values mentioned (-1.3 and 4.5) are the minimum and maximum data values labeled on the bars, not labels on the axis.
The vertical axis does not have any tick marks or tick labels, so stating that it has an interval of 1 is a hallucination.
